channelTitle: Before soup, this was grandma's actual sick-day food
hook: Everyone talks about chicken soup for being sick, but Grandma June's own mother made something even simpler.
remedy: Torn toast soaked in warm, slightly sweetened milk, sometimes called milk toast, is an old-fashioned comfort food for a sick day when nothing else sounds appetizing.
steps: Toast a slice of bread until lightly golden
Warm a cup of milk, not boiling
Tear the toast into a bowl, pour the warm milk over it, and add a little honey or sugar if you like
caution: Honey isn't safe for babies under 1. See a doctor if you can't keep any food down or symptoms get worse.
cta: Milk toast on a sick day, does your family do this too, or is this brand new to you? Tell Grandma June.
